name: AzTEC-1 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant starburst galaxy AzTEC-1, seen by Hubble.
label: aztec1-hubble
story: Somewhere in this patch of the COSMOS field lies AzTEC-1, a dusty submillimeter galaxy forming stars at a ferocious pace in the young universe. Hubble looked here to learn how the earliest massive galaxies took shape.

claims.text: AzTEC-1 is a starburst galaxy in the COSMOS field
AzTEC-1 forms stars at a very high rate
AzTEC-1 is a submillimeter galaxy hosting a compact starburst
The targets of program 13294 are dust-rich starbursts in the COSMOS field
Program 13294 studies the formation of the earliest massive galaxies within 1.5 billion years of the Big Bang
